# Max Smith

> Max (Maxwell) Smith is a software engineer in Mountain View, California, in the San Francisco Bay Area. He grew up in Ankeny, Iowa, and moved west in 2022. This is his personal site; opinions are his own and don't represent any employer.

## Facts

- Current role: Software Engineer at Apple (since 2025). No details about current work are published here.
- Previously: PlayStation (Sony Interactive Entertainment) in San Francisco, 2022–2025. Software Engineering Intern (2022), Software Engineer I (2023), Software Engineer II and technical lead for a PlayStation Network feature (2023–2025). Web, mobile and desktop apps in React and React Native.
- Founder and engineer of SeasonCast (Ankeny, Iowa, 2019–2024), a live-streaming platform for high school and youth sports. He wrote all seven codebases (iOS, Android, web, API, C++ media server). 300,000 monthly users, 6,000 teams a year, 99.995% uptime for more than three years.
- Internships: Hy-Vee (Des Moines, Iowa, 2021; product pages and search for the online grocery site and app), Polaris (Medina, Minnesota, 2020; wrote the NFC library that programs the emblem on 2022 and later snowmobiles, RZRs and ATVs), Tero International (Clive, Iowa, 2019).
- How he works: on personal projects he works with AI coding agents and holds their work to the same bar as anyone's: a small ticket, a check that has to pass, and a review before it merges.
- Education: B.S. Computer Science, Iowa State University (Ames, Iowa), 2022. A.A.S., Des Moines Area Community College, 2019, completed while in high school.
